import numpy as np, itertools, time
U={'1':np.ones_like(A),'A':A,'1/A':1/A,'expA':np.exp(-A),'A2':A**2,'1/A2':1/A**2,'expA/A':np.exp(-A)/A,'Aexp-A':A*np.exp(-A),'logA':np.log(A),'sqrtA':np.sqrt(A)}
V={'1':np.ones_like(t),'1/t':1/t,'expt':np.exp(-t),'t':t,'t2':t**2,'expt+':np.exp(t/3),'logt':np.log(t),'sqrtt':np.sqrt(t),'1/t2':1/t**2,'exp-t/3':np.exp(-t/3)}
cols=[];names=[]
for un,uv in U.items():
    for vn,vv in V.items():
        if un=='1' and vn=='1': continue
        cols.append(uv*vv); names.append(f"{un}*{vn}")
X=np.array(cols).T
# drop duplicates
print(X.shape)
y=dA_dt; vy=np.var(y)
t0=time.time(); best=[]
# greedy 3 + exhaustive best 4th? do full 4 combos with time check
n=X.shape[1]
for c in itertools.combinations(range(n),4):
    M=X[:,c]
    coef=np.linalg.lstsq(M,y,rcond=None)[0]
    r=y-M@coef
    v=np.mean(r**2)/vy
    best.append((v,c))
    if time.time()-t0>15: print("timeout"); break
best.sort()
